title: Bowire project manifest
description: The checked-in .bowire/project.json convention (#172) — a version-controlled MANIFEST that makes a repository the source of truth for what its API looks like. It points (with project-relative paths) at the sources, test suites/collections, an auth flow, scan profiles, and a rules file so CI, the PR bot, and onboarding all resolve the same setup automatically. See docs and Kuestenlogik.Bowire.Projects.BowireProjectFile.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor tooling. Never fetched by Bowire.

version.description: Manifest schema version. The only supported value today is 1.

sources.description: The API sources this project exposes — each a base URL plus zero or more schema files.

url.description: Base URL of the service (e.g. https://api.example.com).

schemas.description: Project-relative schema files describing the source (e.g. ./proto/orders.proto).

suites.description: Named test suites/collections, keyed by a short id (e.g. smoke), each a project-relative path.

security.description: Security configuration — the auth flow to run and the scan profiles to apply.

auth.description: Project-relative path to an auth-flow definition (e.g. ./bowire/auth/login.flow.json).

scan.description: Scan profiles to run (e.g. owasp-api, cve, protocol).

rules.description: Project-relative path to a rules file.
